Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

In order to achieve success in this role the position requires the ability to collaborate effectively across all functions and levels, as well as across international boundaries, with finance teams in the US and Shenzhen, China. Reporting to the US Finance Director, the position is based in São Paulo, Brazil. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Financial Operation: Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger activities. Support customer invoicing and sales tax calculation. Ensure timely and accurate processing of financial transactions. Maintain and improve internal controls and financial procedures. Work with tax consultants to prepare and file tax returns, ensuring compliance with local tax regulations. Own the cash management function and liaison with treasury administrator in US. Budgeting and Forecasting: Participate in the annual budgeting process for MGI Brazil and Actual v Budget analysis. Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions. Commercial Team Support: Build relationships with and support the Brazil Commercial team. Identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvements. QUALIFICATIONS At least 5 years of relevant accounting experience in a fast-paced, fluid, results-oriented, hands-on environment, including with teams that are geographically dispersed across international boundaries. Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial regulations, and reporting standards. Experience with ERP and Financial IT systems (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, etc.) BS/BA degree in Accounting/Finance/Business. CPA a plus. Biotechnology/Medical Devices/Pharmaceutical industry experience and multinational experience; experience with import tax a plus. Proven experience in instrument sales or related industry is a plus. Knowledge of Portuguese and English is required. Chinese language a plus. Must have strong excel skills. BEHAVIORS, SKILLS, AND KNOWLEDGE Team-oriented with outstanding integrity, accuracy, and organizational skills. Ability to proactively identify and solve problems. Exhibits the highest degree of integrity and ethics, with the ability to work independently and with minimal supervision. Strong team player willing to be flexible and to tackle a variety of tasks and responsibilities. Ability to navigate and be successful in a highly matrixed, fast-paced environment. Results-oriented with excellent analytic, communication, and collaboration skills Ability to operate under different business models and complex business structures.

Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Managing director - brazil (crypto payment business)
description:
Confira a vaga para Managing director - brazil (crypto payment business) em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (must currently reside in Brazil with valid Brazilian ID) Language: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory), strong English preferred Overview: We are seeking an experienced, crypto-savvy Managing Director to lead and expand our crypto payment business in Brazil. The ideal candidate must be Brazil-based, with prior experience in crypto, deep knowledge of the local crypto/payment ecosystem, and strong relationships with key regulatory and industry stakeholders. This role is critical to supporting Brazil licensing efforts, including assisting with the DASP licence, and will work closely with the Brazil AMLO on regulatory matters. Key Responsibilities: Support the company in obtaining the DASP licence, collaborating closely with AMLO Brazil on all regulatory submissions and compliance preparations. Build and maintain strong relationships with the Brazilian Central Bank (BCB) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) to support licensing and ongoing regulatory engagement. Expand business development opportunities through a strong local network across crypto, payments, fintech, and financial institutions. Lead Brazil's business strategy and drive growth for all crypto-payment products. Maintain excellent relationships with crypto industry associations such as ABCripto, ABCB, and other relevant bodies. Represent the company as the senior business leader in Brazil, attending industry events, regulatory meetings, and partnership discussions. Collaborate closely with global teams (product, compliance, legal, operations) to ensure commercial success and regulatory alignment. Requirements: Must currently reside in Brazil with a valid Brazilian ID. Prior experience in crypto is a must. 10+ years’ experience in crypto payments, payment institutions, fintech, or related financial services. Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto/payment regulatory environment, including BCB and CVM frameworks. Proven track record and strong personal network with BCB, CVM, and major industry associations (ABCripto, ABCB). Demonstrated ability to support licensing processes for payment or crypto-related entities in Brazil. Strong business development experience, with a proven ability to grow partnerships and drive commercial expansion. Fluent Portuguese; strong English preferred. Entrepreneurial, proactive, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment. Vision & Mission: OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Estamos há 68 anos construindo nossa história e "vivendo junto" dos gaúchos, seja através da TV, do Rádio, do Jornal e do Digital. Por aqui desafios e oportunidades não faltam e só crescem a medida que evoluímos. REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS    Formação superior completa em Administração, Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas afins;  Desejável especialização em Marketing Digital;  Experiência e conhecimento técnico em marketing digital;  Perfil comunicativo, com ótimo relacionamento interpessoal e que tenha aptidão para criar oportunidades de negócios.  ADDITIONAL INFORMATION    O prazo de inscrições para os candidatos internos é até 03/04/2026.   Somos o Grupo RBS    A RBS é feita de pessoas.   Nossas pessoas estão engajadas com o nosso propósito e são comprometidas com os resultados. Acreditamos na diversidade de habilidades, de vivências e de opiniões e, por isso, queremos ter as pessoas certas nos lugares certos para fazer a diferença.  Nosso ambiente organizacional é leve e colaborativo. Nosso modelo de trabalho é flexível (presencial, híbrido ou remoto), contemporâneo e permite gerar maior valor para as pessoas e para os negócios. Aqui aceitamos as pessoas como elas são, pois acreditamos que a diversidade de pensamento gera inovação e evolução. A vontade de aprender é genuína e nos faz crescer juntos a cada novo desafio. Nossa vida está ligada à de cada gaúcho e estamos em um processo de evolução constante.  Temos um ambiente de trabalho com líderes inspiradores, possibilidades de crescimento, envolvimento em projetos disruptivos e de impacto social legítimo.  Valorizamos trabalhar com energia, excelência, disciplina, resiliência e simplicidade no dia a dia. Somos uma única RBS, conectada para responder com consistência e agilidade os desafios que surgem e com uma única cultura, integrada e flexível.  Se você também quer impactar positivamente a nossa sociedade, venha fazer parte desta equipe que acredita que com jornalismo, esporte e entretenimento podemos contribuir para uma vida melhor.

title: Agente de negócios
description:
Nova oportunidade para Agente de negócios em osasco. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Sobre o Bradesco   O Bradesco é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil, com uma história marcada pelo pioneirismo e inovação. Por meio da nossa carteira amplamente diversificada de produtos financeiros, serviços bancários e de seguros contribuímos com a realização das pessoas e o crescimento sustentável de empresas e sociedade. Venha fazer parte do nosso ecossistema financeiro e impactar a experiência de milhões de pessoas!  No Bradesco valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Por isso, as nossas vagas são abertas a todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, deficiência, idade ou qualquer outra característica.  Saiba mais em  Banco de Talentos   Estamos ampliando nosso Banco de Talentos para o cargo de Agente de Negócios em todo o Brasil!  Se você possui experiência com atendimento ao cliente, afinidade com a área comercial e atende aos pré-requisitos da função, cadastre-se e, assim que surgir uma oportunidade na sua região, você poderá fazer parte do nosso processo seletivo.  Responsabilidades e atribuições   A Rede de Agências do Bradesco é o principal ponto de contato com nossos clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos com foco em relacionamento, oferecendo soluções financeiras personalizadas, promovendo inclusão e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde estamos presentes. Aqui, valorizamos o atendimento humanizado, a escuta ativa e a construção de vínculos duradouros com nossos clientes.  Como será seu dia a dia?   Como Agente de Negócios suas principais atividades serão:  ·Realizar atendimento consultivo a clientes e não clientes, identificando necessidades e orientando sobre canais de atendimento;  ·Apoiar nas rotinas operacionais e administrativas da agência, como abertura de contas, atualização cadastral e encaminhamento de demandas;  ·Promover e oferecer soluções financeiras adequadas e produtos e serviços do banco, como investimentos, seguros, consórcios e crédito;  ·Contribuir para a fidelização e satisfação dos clientes, fortalecendo o relacionamento com o banco;  Requisitos e Qualificações   O que você precisa ter ou saber?  ·Ensino superior completo ou em andamento;  ·Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;  ·Facilidade para trabalhar com atendimento ao público;  Será um diferencial se você tiver:  Certificação CPA-20 ou superior.  O que nós oferecemos   No Bradesco valorizamos a saúde e bem-estar, oferecendo um extenso portfólio de benefícios a todas nossas pessoas funcionárias.  ·PLR ou Bônus: Conforme a elegibilidade de cargo*;  ·Convênio Médico;  ·Convênio Odontológico;  ·Seguro de Vida;  ·Vale Alimentação;  ·Vale Refeição;  ·Total Pass;  ·13º Cesta Alimentação;  ·Vale Transporte (adesão opcional);  ·Descontos em produtos e serviços em empresas parceiras;  ·Previdência Privada (adesão opcional, com participação financeira da Organização Bradesco);  ·Viva Bem Bradesco: programa de saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida;  ·Unibrad: Universidade Corporativa Bradesco;  ·Isenção de Tarifas: condições especiais em diversos produtos e serviços;  ·Auxílio Creche ou Babá;  ·Licença Paternidade estendida de 20 dias;  ·Licença Maternidade de 180 dias, acompanhamento assistencial da gestação até o pós-parto.  Etapas do Processo Seletivo:   1. Análise de Perfil   Avaliaremos as inscrições com base na aderência ao perfil da vaga.  2. Avaliações Online   Você realizará testes para avaliarmos sua compatibilidade com a nossa cultura, além de conhecimentos gerais e raciocínio lógico.  3. Vídeo Entrevista   Grave um vídeo respondendo perguntas relacionadas à área para a qual você foi indicado(a).  4. Processo Admissional   Última etapa! Aqui você entregará os documentos necessários e realizará o exame médico admissional.  Importante:   Algumas etapas são eliminatórias. As pessoas candidatas receberão atualizações sobre o andamento do processo por e-mail. Fique de olho na sua caixa de entrada (e no spam também!).

Saber analisar e defender propostas de baixa e média complexidade, analisando capacidade de pagamento, risco da operação e garantias, objetivando fomentar a liberação de crédito de forma sustentável.  Apoiar e manter os contratos da Unidade de Atendimento organizados, realizando a digitalização e organização dos contratos, buscando manter o físico guardado conforme data estipulada pela cooperativa.  Realizar cobrança e acionamento de devedores, conforme relatórios, realizando contato, bem como analisando e atuando nos casos de PDD (provisão do devedor duvidoso) e inadimplência observando questões de risco, com acompanhamento, visando a gestão da carteira de inadimplentes.  Organizar os documentos da Unidade de Atendimento, enviando e recebendo os malotes, materiais de comunicação, cartões, talões de cheques, cheques devolvidos, arquivo, brindes Ailos Educação Cooperados, materiais de expediente, visando mitigar os riscos operacionais.  Acompanhar os painéis e os números da Unidade de Atendimento, acessando os dados, buscando mobilizar o time e aplicar as estratégias de negócios e o atingimento dos resultados estabelecidos. Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:   Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;  Inglês intermediário;  Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS e ISS);  Habilidades avançadas de comunicação verbal e escrita;  Habilidades de gestão de projetos;  Dedicação ao trabalho em equipe e à liderança.  Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:   Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, Compliance e Planejamento Tributário;  Conhecimento em Digital TAX.  O que oferecemos:   Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Clique e conheça nosso universo de benefícios  .  Quem somos?   Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.   Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para Pc D. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.   Segundo o   Great Place to Work 2022, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Além disso,   você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade. Clinical Research Associate (CRA II) – Oncology São Paulo Full-time | Travel required The Role We are seeking a Clinical Research Associate (CRA II) with at least 1 year of on-site monitoring experience in oncology to support the successful delivery of clinical trials. Work on oncology-focused clinical trials with meaningful patient impact Join a biotech-focused CRO environment known for agility and scientific alignment Gain exposure to high-quality studies and collaborative project teams Continue developing your CRA career within complex and innovative trials

Empresa está contratando Strategy consultant em vinhedo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Company Description Marais Advisory is a boutique consulting firm specializing in AI implementation and competitive intelligence for enterprise clients. The firm emphasizes practical AI integration within existing infrastructure to drive strategic business transformation. With expertise in AWS, GCP, and Azure, Marais Advisory delivers end-to-end solutions covering enterprise AI roadmaps, evaluation frameworks, and multi-agent systems for competitive intelligence. The firm partners with organizations ranging from private equity to telecommunications, tailoring solutions like Service Now integrations and automated competitive intelligence systems. Marais Advisory prides itself on a results-driven approach, combining technical excellence and strategic insight to enable clients to seamlessly adapt in the AI era. Role Description This is a full-time remote role for an Strategy Consultant. The Strategy Consultant will be responsible for advising clients on AI strategy, implementing data-driven solutions, and conducting research in fields like natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing complex datasets, designing AI roadmaps, creating evaluation frameworks, and leveraging pattern recognition techniques. The Consultant will also collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to ensure the practical deployment of AI solutions. Qualifications Proficiency in Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP) Experience in Data Science and Pattern Recognition methodologies Strong consulting skills with the ability to advise on AI strategies and business integration Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, and programming skills in Python or related technologies Effective communication and collaboration skills to interface with diverse stakeholders Relevant professional experience in AI, data science, or enterprise technology consulting A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field is preferred

Na AVVA, a área comercial é o motor que conecta nosso propósito a mais pessoas. Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Vendas para liderar a equipe que guia a jornada do cliente, desde o primeiro contato até a sua plena integração em nossa comunidade. description:

About Eightpoint Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U. S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love. About the Role The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the Dev Ops team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the Dev Ops and Systems Administration teams. Key Responsibilities Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment Support GCP workloads, primarily Big Query pipelines and related data infrastructure. Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling. Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions, including self-hosted runners. Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation. Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; Cloud Watch; One Uptime). Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform. Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones. Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures. Who You Are5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, Dev Ops, or infrastructure support role. Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Cloud Front). Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker). Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions. Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA. Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting). Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python). Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code. Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence). Preferred Qualifications Experience with GCP, specifically Big Query and related data services. Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro). Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms. AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, Sys Ops, or Dev Ops Engineer). Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging. Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Finance management trainee (latam/chinese speaking)
description:
Confira a vaga para Finance management trainee (latam/chinese speaking) em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

工作职责：经营支持与CEO助理：协助地区部CEO处理日常经营管理事务；跟进重点业务决策的执行与落地；参与经营数据分析与业务复盘。本地合规与公司运营：主导或协助海外公司注册、变更、年审及银行账户开设；确保属地法律、财务及税务合规。总部政策落地：作为总部与地区部之间的接口，推动财务及管理制度在海外落地；协助建立区域财务流程与内控体系。项目全周期管理：跟进项目 pipeline（投标、执行、回款）；参与预算编制、成本控制及项目经营分析；支持项目盈利能力提升。财务评审与风险控制：参与项目财务评审及投标支持；审核合同财税条款；识别并预警海外项目财务与税务风险。税务与资金管理：学习并执行当地税务申报及相关政策；参与税务筹划及现金流管理；协助应对税务检查。综合运营支持：协助属地招聘、薪酬核算及人事管理；支持签证办理及行政事务。任职资格：专业背景：会计学、财务管理、税务、金融、经济学、国际经济与贸易等相关专业；辅修法律/商法优先。能力要求：具备良好的英语和葡萄牙语能力（可作为工作语言）；具备较强的数据分析能力和逻辑思维能力；对业务及商业运营有兴趣，具备财务与业务结合意识；良好的沟通能力及跨文化适应能力；具备较强的学习能力与执行力。

title: Cloud operations engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Cloud operations engineer em anápolis. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Eightpoint Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U. S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love. About the Role The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the Dev Ops team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the Dev Ops and Systems Administration teams. Key Responsibilities Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment Support GCP workloads, primarily Big Query pipelines and related data infrastructure. Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling. Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions, including self-hosted runners. Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation. Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; Cloud Watch; One Uptime). Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform. Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones. Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures. Who You Are5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, Dev Ops, or infrastructure support role. Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Cloud Front). Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker). Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions. Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA. Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting). Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python). Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code. Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence). Preferred Qualifications Experience with GCP, specifically Big Query and related data services. Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro). Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms. AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, Sys Ops, or Dev Ops Engineer). Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging. Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

Customer Service Representative Location: Fully Remote (LATAM) Job Type: Full-Time Love helping people and solving problems fast?We're looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day. About Uproot Clean Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability. Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth. The Role This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses. You arenotjust answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand. This Role Is For You If: You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly You pay attention to details and don't let things slip You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment This Role Is NOT For You If: You avoid dealing with difficult customers You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms What You'll Do Customer Support Execution Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice Social Media Support Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and Tik Tok Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency Order & Refund Management Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed Conflict Resolution Handle complaints with empathy and clarity Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions Cross-Functional Collaboration Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations Requirements Must have: Experience in customer service(ecommerce or DTC preferred) Strongwritten communication skills in English Experiencehandling social media interactions is a strong plus Highattention to detail and ability to multitask Comfortableworking in fast-paced environments Work Requirements Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)Benefits & Compensation Fully remote- work from anywhere in LATAM. Paid time off Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire Ownership & autonomy- trusted to build and execute strategy Professional development- opportunities to learn and grow with the business Ready to Apply? If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

title: Cloud operations engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Cloud operations engineer em são josé dos campos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Eightpoint Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U. S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love. About the Role The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the Dev Ops team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the Dev Ops and Systems Administration teams. Key Responsibilities Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment Support GCP workloads, primarily Big Query pipelines and related data infrastructure. Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling. Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions, including self-hosted runners. Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation. Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; Cloud Watch; One Uptime). Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform. Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones. Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures. Who You Are5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, Dev Ops, or infrastructure support role. Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Cloud Front). Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker). Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions. Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA. Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting). Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python). Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code. Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence). Preferred Qualifications Experience with GCP, specifically Big Query and related data services. Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro). Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms. AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, Sys Ops, or Dev Ops Engineer). Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging. Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Graphic designer
description:
Confira a vaga para Graphic designer em diadema. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Graphic Designer  Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.  You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.  What you’ll do   You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns  Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web  Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow  Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns  Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG) Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations  Edit video for social distribution and website use  Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative  This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.    What matters in this role   You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction  You understand how design actually shows up in B2 B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio  You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time  You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement  You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks    Requirements   4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams  Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals  Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts) Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video) Video editing experience for social and web content  Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite    Context for the work   Our client sells to B2 B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:  Driving registrations and product demos  Increasing engagement  Supporting sales follow-up  Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders    The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.  What this is not   Not a pure brand exploration role  Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment  Not isolated design work handed over a wall    You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.  If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Diretor(a) de Pessoas & Performance
description:

Nosso jeito de ser e fazer  O time da Appmax é feito por pessoas mão na massa, que têm os valores de garra e colaboração em 1º lugar. Nos esforçamos todos os dias para que empreendedores digitais consigam vender mais, de uma maneira mais eficiente e mais fácil. Nos inspiramos nos nossos clientes, e estamos aqui para servi-los e fornecer ferramentas que irão potencializar e maximizar seus resultados. Se você também quer participar dessa jornada conosco, se inscreva e venha fazer parte!  Diretor(a) de Pessoas & Performance  Esta posição é estratégica para o negócio e atua como parceira direta dos founders e do C-level. Buscamos uma liderança capaz de conectar estratégia, estrutura, liderança e resultados, construindo sistemas de gestão que garantam que a empresa tenha as pessoas certas, nos lugares certos, com metas e incentivos alinhados aos objetivos estratégicos. Não se trata de RH tradicional, mas de transformar direcionamento estratégico em execução consistente por meio de dados, clareza e accountability, impulsionando crescimento, eficiência e resultado.  Responsabilidades   Traduzir a estratégia da companhia em estrutura organizacional, papéis, metas e incentivos claros;  Atuar de forma próxima aos founders e ao C-level em decisões críticas de estrutura, performance e direcionamento estratégico;  Construir e acompanhar KPIs de pessoas conectados diretamente aos KPIs de negócio;  Implementar e evoluir um sistema contínuo de performance e accountability;  Desenvolver líderes para atuarem como gestores de negócio e pessoas;  Sustentar uma cultura prática, mensurável e coerente com a estratégia da companhia;  Garantir alinhamento entre crescimento organizacional, eficiência operacional e resultado financeiro.    Qualificações   Experiência sólida com gestão de pessoas, liderança e performance em empresas de crescimento acelerado;  Forte orientação a negócio e conforto com dados, métricas e indicadores;  Experiência estruturando sistemas de gestão e performance executiva;  Capacidade de influenciar, confrontar e sustentar decisões difíceis;  Pensamento sistêmico, visão de dono(a) e foco consistente em execução.    O que não buscamos   RH exclusivamente administrativo ou operacional;  Atuação desconectada de números, metas e estratégia;  Pessoas que evitam conversas difíceis ou que busquem consenso a qualquer custo;  Perfis que não se sintam confortáveis trabalhando com foco direto em resultados de negócio.    Benefícios   Todos os equipamentos e recursos necessários para realizar o trabalho em modelo presencial, híbrido ou remoto  Ajuda de custo para despesas para quem atua no formato híbrido ou remoto  Flexfood, assim você não precisa escolher entre VR ou VA  Plano de Saúde e Odontológico  ️♀️ Wellhub  Avus  Starbem  Convênio farmácia  Vale transporte  ❤️ Seguro de vida  Upmaxter para auxiliar nos seus estudos  Um ambiente que favorece e incentiva o desenvolvimento e o alto desempenho com checkpoints mensais de performance, práticas de 1:1, rotinas de feedbacks contínuos, acompanhamento do PDI e muito mais     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Sr. Manager/ Manager AI Software Engineer New São Paulo
description:
Confira a vaga para Sr. Manager/ Manager AI Software Engineer New São Paulo em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Appnovation is a global, full-service digital partner that combines Strategy, Experience & Design, Engineering and Managed Services. We build digital solutions that deliver real impact today and serve as foundations for future growth. Bold ambition. Practical action. Endless possibilities.  About the Role  Join forces with Appnovation to deliver high-impact results for one of our key strategic partners - a global leader in their field. This engagement offers a unique vantage point into a world-class organization with exceptional opportunities for professional growth and long-term career advancement  As a Senior AI Software Engineer, you'll transform business ideas into production-ready applications using cutting-edge AI design tools and modern full-stack frameworks. With a strong bias toward frontend development, you specialize in the critical early stages—from concept through pre-totype to prototype—where design systems meet AI-augmented development. You are a visionary technologist who sits at the intersection of engineering excellence and AI innovation. Your mission is to oversee the entire "concept-to-production" pipeline, ensuring our teams leverage cutting-edge AI tools to deliver enterprise-grade applications at unprecedented speeds.  While you maintain a deep technical foundation in full-stack development, your primary focus is strategic leadership: defining design system standards, optimizing AI-augmented workflows, and mentoring a high-performance team of developers and AI builders.  Key Responsibilities   Strategic AI Integration:  Direct the adoption of AI design tools (v0.dev, bolt.new, Lovable) to compress the development lifecycle from weeks to days without sacrificing quality.  Architecture & Standards:  Define and enforce the technical standards for production-ready full-stack applications, ensuring scalability, performance, and accessibility across all projects.  Design-Dev Synthesis:  Lead the integration of Figma-based design systems with AI-driven development to create seamless, automated handoff processes.  Operational Excellence:  Manage a ticket-driven workflow in Jira, optimizing team velocity and ensuring technical documentation meets enterprise-level requirements.  Cross-Functional Partnership:  Act as a bridge between Strategy, Creative, and Technology departments to ensure AI-powered solutions meet complex business objectives.  Backend & Data Strategy:  Oversee the implementation of robust backend services (Supabase, SQL/NoSQL) and secure authentication frameworks (OAuth, JWT) across the portfolio.  Design and implement RESTful APIs and backend services using platforms like Supabase to support frontend functionality.  Collaborate with UX Designers, AI Builders, and Innovation Leads throughout the development lifecycle.    Qualification   6–10+ years in full-stack development, with at least 3+ years in a management capacity. Bonus points if you have experience working in a startup or rapid prototyping environment.  Proven track record of implementing AI design tools(such as v0.dev, bolt.new, Lovable, or similar platforms) and workflow automation (e.g., N8N) within a professional engineering team.  Deep expertise in modern frameworks (React, Vue, Nuxt), TypeScript, and multiple backend languages including Python, PHP, and NodeJS.  Expert-level knowledge of design systems, design tokens, and CSS frameworks (Tailwind) to ensure brand consistency at scale.  Comprehensive understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), deployment workflows, and enterprise security patterns.  Solid understanding of backend development, including API design (REST, GraphQL), server-side logic, and database management.  Proficiency with authentication mechanisms (OAuth, JWT) and security best practices.  Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including design system management and component libraries.  A portfolio demonstrating not just individual code, but the leadership of complex, full-stack applications built using AI-augmented methodologies.  Strong attention to detail and a passion for innovation.  Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.    What Appnovation Offers   Challenging and rewarding work with real impact  Growth opportunities for personal and professional development  Exposure to exciting projects and high-profile clients  Supportive work environment with access to company leaders    Here are a few more reasons why you should apply:   Work-life Balance  Lots of opportunities for personal and professional growth  Health Benefits Package  Mental Health Support  Personal Days Off  Fertility and Menopause Leave  Fitness Allowance  D,E&I Initiatives  And much more...    Thank you for your interest in a career with Appnovation Technologies! Please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.  At Appnovation, we recognize that diverse teams are the strongest teams. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is not only something that we embrace - we celebrate it! We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage applicants from all backgrounds, lived experiences and industries to apply. Come join us at Appnovation, and learn more about how we stay true to our company values as we build better lives through better digital.  Accommodations are available upon request throughout the recruitment process.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Responsabilidades e Atribuições   Definir a Visão Estratégica: Estabelecer o roadmap de longo prazo para Dados e IA, alinhando as iniciativas técnicas aos objetivos macro do negócio;  Arquitetura e Escalabilidade: Supervisionar a evolução das plataformas (Data, ML e AI), garantindo decisões arquiteturais que privilegiem escalabilidade, segurança, governança e eficiência de custos;  Democratização e Governança: Estruturar não apenas o consumo, mas a governança corporativa de dados, garantindo qualidade, privacidade e acessibilidade em toda a organização;  Impulsionar GenAI e Inovação: Liderar a adoção de IA Generativa e preditiva, identificando use cases de alto ROI e garantindo o uso ético e responsável da IA;  Parceria Executiva: Atuar como parceiro estratégico do C-Level e Diretores, traduzindo complexidade técnica em valor de negócio e identificando novas linhas de receita ou eficiência operacional através de dados;  Promover a cultura de dados na organização, impulsionando práticas de data literacy, uso consciente e democratização de dados com responsabilidade;  Conduzir práticas de IA responsável e ética, incluindo fairness e XAI;  Gestão de Rotina: estabelecer rituais de acompanhamento, KPIs e governança de entregas.  Gestão de KPIs: monitorar métricas como acurácia, custo por pipeline, tempo de ciclo e ROI de IA;  Gestão de Processos: supervisionar fluxos de experimentação, revisão e auditorias de ML;  Gestão de Projetos: conduzir projetos de IA ponta a ponta, da concepção à entrega;  Desenvolver e liderar a estratégia de governança de dados e IA, garantindo aderência às normas regulatórias e melhores práticas de mercado;  Estruturar, formar e desenvolver o time de governança de dados e IA, incluindo a definição de papéis, responsabilidades, rotinas e indicadores de desempenho da área;  Atuar como ponto focal de governança junto aos stTrabalhoakeholders internos, promovendo o uso eficiente, seguro e responsável dos dados e modelos de IA. title: Gerente de Business Analytics
description:
Confira a vaga para Gerente de Business Analytics em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga  A Minerva Foods  é líder na exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a empresa está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.  Com suas 46 unidades industriais, oferece produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, comercializados para clientes em todo o mundo por meio de 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.  A área de Business Analytics  tem como propósito resolver problemas de negócio utilizando dados, algoritmos e técnicas estatísticas aplicadas a finalidades específicas. As principais áreas de aplicação são: logística, comercial, operação industrial (Indústria 4.0), pricing e otimização de produção.  Responsabilidades e atribuições  O Gerente de Business Analytics  será responsável pela área de BT (Business Translator) e projetos , que traduz as necessidades do negócio em soluções analíticas baseadas em dados acompanhando a implantação do produto de dados do início ao fim. O profissional deve atuar com uma visão transversal do negócio, mantendo proximidade com as áreas envolvidas para gerar soluções eficazes utilizando técnicas avançadas de analytics. Também será responsável pelo time de projetos, conduzindo o roadmap de implantação dos produtos de dados e aplicando metodologias clássicas de gestão de projetos.  Requisitos e qualificações   Manter contato constante com as áreas de negócio para identificar oportunidades de melhoria de processos ou geração de informações estratégicas por meio de modelos preditivos, técnicas de machine learning, otimização e pesquisa operacional.  Gerenciar o time responsável por traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas, garantindo clareza para o time técnico durante a implantação.  Conduzir reuniões com desenvoltura, compreendendo as necessidades das áreas e transformando-as em oportunidades de projeto.  Validar e avaliar soluções analíticas, de ciência de dados e pesquisa operacional, direcionando as melhores alternativas para cada desafio.  Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos , analisando cronogramas, identificando pontos críticos e reconhecendo todos os stakeholders envolvidos.  Ter conhecimento em change management  para aplicação em diversos projetos da área.  Elaborar documentação de projetos e documentação funcional das soluções, atuando como interface com as áreas clientes e garantindo a cadência das entregas — com início, meio e fim bem definidos.    Requisitos e qualificações    Ensino superior completo.  Pós-graduação, mestrado ou doutorado serão considerados diferenciais.  Conhecimento imprescindível em técnicas de modelagem estatística, machine learning e/ou pesquisa operacional.  Experiência mínima de 7 anos  em Business Analytics / Analytics  Experiência mínima de 3 anos  como gestor de equipe.  Conhecimento lógico e técnico em SQL  e Python .    Informações adicionais  Desejável:    Inglês em nível avançado.  Espanhol em nível intermediário.    Diferencial:    Experiência prévia como gestor ou líder de equipes em áreas analíticas.    Informações adicionais    Local de trabalho:  Híbrido (4 dias presenciais).  Carga horária:  44 horas semanais.  Cidades:  São Paulo ou Campinas.  País:  Brasil.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Gerente Executivo de Planejamento e Demanda
description:
Confira a vaga para Gerente Executivo de Planejamento e Demanda em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga  A Flora é uma empresa que tem o cuidado como essência. Trabalhamos todos os dias com carinho e dedicação e temos orgulho em distribuir por todo o país nossos produtos, presentes no dia a dia de milhares de brasileiros.  Somos guiados por nossos valores, temosAtitude de dono,Determinação,Disciplina,Disponibilidade,Simplicidade,FranquezaeHumildade. O nosso crescimento é resultado do comprometimento de cada pessoa e o nosso sucesso, compartilhado em time. Trabalhar conosco é evoluir, se conectar e acreditar em fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.  Responsabilidades e atribuições  Missão:  O Gerente será responsável por liderar a área de Planejamento da Flora englobando Demand Planning, S&OP/IBP, Planejamento Mestre de Produção (própria e terceirizada), Gestão de produção em terceiros (planejamento de produção, materiais e inventário), atuando de forma estratégica e tática integrada na gestão do planejamento e da demanda , garantindo o equilíbrio entre previsão de vendas, capacidades produtivas, níveis de estoque, eficiência operacional e nível de serviço ao cliente,  assegurando suporte às decisões do negócio, sustentabilidade financeira e crescimento da companhia.  Principais Responsabilidades:    Liderar o processo de Demand Planning , assegurando previsões assertivas e consistentes  de curto, médio e longo prazo, alinhadas à estratégia do negócio.  Integrar e consolidar informações  das áreas de Vendas, Marketing, Trade Marketing, Operações, Supply Chain e Finanças , garantindo alinhamento, visão única da demanda e tomada de decisão integrada.  Propor e executar plano estruturado de melhoria e aprimoramento do processo de S&OP , focando no aumento da maturidade deste processo, aumento da acuracidade da previsão de demanda, minimização das restrições de disponibilidade de produto e aumento de nível de serviço alinhado com as necessidades dos negócios.  Coordenar e conduzir o processo de S&OP / IBP , participando ativamente das reuniões operacionais e executivas , assegurando governança, qualidade das informações e direcionamento estratégico.  Analisar tendências de mercado , histórico de vendas, lançamentos, promoções e sazonalidades, realizando ajustes contínuos na previsão de demanda .  Liderar o time responsável pelo processo de Planejamento Mestre de Produção de todo portfólio de produto acabado dos negócios de Home Care e Personal Care , garantindo otimização das capacidades de produção das fábricas próprias da Flora, bem como da capacidade de produção dos Terceiros, procurando minimizar as restrições de atendimento e focando na maximização da disponibilidade de produtos.  Liderar o time responsável pelo Planejamento de Produção de Terceiros de Personal Care , garantindo alinhamento dos planos de produção com os Provedores, planejamento de materiais para atendimento das produções, disponibilidade de materiais no prazo para os Terceiros e execução dos follow ups de entrega junto aos parceiros,  com foco nas entregas dos planos de produção acordados.  Gerir o processo de planejamento de abastecimento das plantas terceiras e planta própria com materiais provenientes do Operador Logístico  que centraliza o recebimento das compras de fornecedores diretos.  Monitorar, analisar e aprimorar continuamente os indicadores de desempenho , incluindo acurácia da previsão, nível de serviço, rupturas, giro e cobertura de estoque .  Garantir o dimensionamento adequado dos estoques , equilibrando nível de serviço, capital de giro e eficiência operacional, minimizando rupturas, excessos e obsolescência .  Apoiar e definir, em conjunto com as áreas envolvidas, as políticas de estoque  (mínimo, máximo e estoque de segurança).  Desenvolver cenários de demanda e produção , análises de risco e planos de contingência  frente a variações de mercado, restrições operacionais ou mudanças estratégicas.  Liderar, desenvolver e capacitar a equipe de Planejamento de Demanda, Planejamento Mestre de Produção e Planejamento de Terceiros  promovendo cultura analítica, melhoria contínua e alta performance.  Elaborar e apresentar relatórios, análises e apresentações executivas , traduzindo dados complexos em insights estratégicos  para suporte à tomada de decisão.    Requisitos e qualificações  O que você precisa ter:    Superior em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Logística  ou áreas correlatas.  Experiência:   Vasta  experiência em áreas como: Planejamento de Demanda, Planejamento Mestre de Produção, S&OP / IBP e Supply Chain .  Diferencial: Certificação APICS    Conhecimentos técnicos importantes:    Gestão de demanda (Demand Planning) e previsões e curto, médio e longo prazo. Conhecimento em análise de dados, estatística e ferramentas de previsão.  Processo de S&OP e governança de processos.  Gestão de capacidade de produção (Master Production Planning) e equilíbrio entre fabricas próprias e terceiras  Otimização de inventário atrelado a nível de serviço a clientes (disponibilidade de produtos)  Identificação de riscos de suprimentos de produtos e cenários de planos de mitigação.  Melhoria contínua de processos. Para sua mobilidade:    Estacionamento no local.    Para seu bem-estar:    Frutas no café da manhã;  Gympass e/ou TotalPass;  Assistência médica e odontológica (com coparticipação);  Seguro de vida.    Para quem cuida de alguém:    Auxílio creche para colaboradoras com filhos pequenos;  Kit maternidade especial, com todo carinho da Flora;  Canal Flora Cuida: um espaço de acolhimento emocional e orientação para diferentes momentos da vida. title: Director
description:
Empresa está contratando Director em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Why Join Us?  Be a hero for our rare disease patients. At Ultragenyx, we fundamentally believe that taking real impactful action to care for the needs of patients and our people is always the right thing to do. To achieve this goal, our vision is to lead the future of rare disease medicine. For us, this means going where other biopharma companies won’t go – challenging the status quo and creating a new model that advances our field so more patients and caregivers can benefit from life-changing treatments. We do this by following the science, applying a novel rapid development approach, making innovative medicines at fair and reasonable prices, and creating a collaborative ecosystem to reach patients in ways that are most meaningful for them. Our commitment and care for patients extends to our people, so culture is an essential cornerstone for Ultragenyx. We remain continuously focused on creating a supportive and inclusive environment of profound learning and growth – so employees can thrive in all areas of their lives, in and outside of work. Ultimately, we want to be an organization where we would be proud for our family, friends and children to work. If you want to have a meaningful impact, do the best work of your career, and grow a lot, both professionally and personally, come join our team.  Position Summary  Ultra focused – Work together to fearlessly uncover new possibilities.  Ultragenyx is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Director, Regulatory Affairs Brazil who is a team player and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment. The Director will be responsible for developing key regulatory strategies and lead the execution of submissions in Brazil while monitoring and assessing applicable regulations including Gene Therapy guidance and regulation changes. The Director will work closely with regional and global regulatory colleagues, functional areas, and project teams to support regulatory activities in Brazil as a key market in the Latin America region. The Director, Regulatory Affairs Brazil will be based in Sao Paulo, Brazil with a hybrid model requiring some office-days. The position will report to the Senior Director, Regulatory Affairs LATAM.  Work Model  Flex: This role will typically require onsite work 2‑3 days each week or more depending on business needs. In many locations, the business will set certain days each week that Flex employees are required to be onsite.  Responsibilities   Be responsible for all Regulatory Affairs strategies for the portfolio and pipeline in Brazil.  Provides strategic and technical input on regulatory requirements to development teams, at regulatory sub teams and to leadership.  Lead assessments of Life Cycle Management changes to provide strategic guidance and expert support to global teams by applying technical knowledge, experience and creative solutions.  Leads all planning, preparation, and execution of regulatory interactions with ANVISA and other agencies in Brazil for select programs.  Represent Brazil Regulatory in sub team meetings, serving as the point of contact for the assigned products, and interfacing with functional areas including Research, Development and Clinical in strategic development for late‑stage products.  Oversees submission processes and leads major applications in Brazil (e.g. MAAs, CTAs, LCM, GMPc).  Lead regulatory partnerships with key stakeholders to deliver innovative strategies, facilitating interactions with local partners/consultants.  Manage preparation of responses to questions to ANSIVA and/or any health authorities in Brazil as well as prepare comments on draft documentation sent out for consultation from the health authority.  Develop and implement regulatory policies, processes, and SOP in Brazil in compliance with Ultragenyx SOPs.  Creates, coordinates and maintains submission schedules and timelines with regulatory operations and the cross functional team, ensuring timely delivery of high‑quality documents.  Keep current with Brazil and relevant Agency guidelines and regulations.  Act as Pharmacovigilance (PV) Deputy in the absence of the Brazilian Pharmacovigilance Responsible, where all PV responsibilities will be delegated to the deputy through a documented handover process.  Contribute to creation of local labels as needed.  Be regulatory partner and lead contribution in Veeva PromoMats process as needed.  Provides supervision and mentoring to junior regulatory professionals on the team, if applicable.  Participate in cross‑functional committees and sub‑teams in accordance with company initiatives, as necessary.  Strategic participation in trade associations meetings such as SINDUSFARMA is required.    Requirements   Pharmacy degree preferred or BA/BS degree in life sciences and 10 years of relevant experience working in Regulatory in the pharmaceutical/ biotech industry. Advanced degree preferred.  The candidate must have hands on experience for at least 5 years with regulatory filings biologics/biotech and specialized therapies in Brazil, as well as preferred experience with Gene Therapies and other compounds for the treatment of rare diseases.  In depth understanding and application of industry standards and international/ ANVISA regulations and guidelines for MAA/CTAs/LCM drug registration processes.  Sound knowledge of global regulatory framework, drug development and post approval requirements including foreign regulations and WHO/ICH is required.  Experience working with high effectiveness and building strong partnerships with key internal and external stakeholders.  Experience in communicating regulatory strategy, submission documents and plans both internally and externally.  The desire and ability to work in a fast‑paced, start‑up environment, eager to learn/apply new skills.  Requires initiative, able to work independently, creative problem‑solving ability, hands‑on willing to work, and excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English. Spanish is a plus. Please complete your application and submit your CV in English.  Demonstrated ability to strategize, prioritize, contribute to decision‑making and manage with project management skills multiple tasks simultaneously.    #LI-CT1 #LI-Hybrid  Benefits  Full Time employees across the globe enjoy a range of benefits, including, but not limited to: Generous vacation time and public holidays observed by the company Volunteer days Long term incentive and Employee stock purchase plans or equivalent offerings Employee wellbeing benefits Fitness reimbursement Tuition sponsoring Professional development plans * Benefits vary by region and country  Equal Opportunity Employment  Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, age, disability, marital and veteran status, and any other status or classification protected by applicable federal, state, and/or local laws. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.
