title: Cloud & DevOps Engineering, Principal
description:
Confira a vaga para Cloud & DevOps Engineering, Principal em região geográfica intermediária de são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Seagull Software, LLC, is a global leader in real-time, item-level visibility and label management solutions, dedicated to powering the world’s most complex supply chains with innovative tools for traceability, authentication, and automated inventory management. Our BarTender™️ platform enables businesses across all industries to design, manage, print, and automate the production of labels, barcodes, and RFID tags, ensuring seamless tracking and compliance for over 100 billion unique identifiers each year. Leveraging the Mojix™️ high‑security, scalable SaaS traceability platform, Seagull delivers end‑to‑end intelligence, harmonizing data to drive operational efficiency, enhance customer experiences, and reduce risk. Learn more at   LOCATION  This direct contractor position is remote in Brazil or LATAM.  JOB SUMMARY  The Cloud & DevOps Engineering Principal  leads the Operations functions responsible for the architecture, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of our multi‑cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP. This role manages a team of CloudOps and DevOps engineers, defines operating standards, and partners closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Security to ensure our platforms are secure, scalable, and highly available.  This role supports the execution of the broader CloudOps and DevOps strategy , helping to translate high‑level direction into concrete operational practices for cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and release management.  The role also contributes to the governance and continuous improvement of build and release processes across SaaS and on‑premise environments, in alignment with CloudOps leadership.  The role is deeply embedded in product development, overseeing the operational impact of new features end‑to‑end, from architectural design and delivery workflows to scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. This position safeguards the long‑term health of the platform by ensuring that new capabilities align with established business processes, preserve performance at scale, and follow a clear, predictable, and repeatable development lifecycle across SaaS and on‑premise environments, in close partnership with CloudOps, DevOps and Engineering leadership.  As a Cloud & DevOps Engineering Principal, you will shape the roadmap for Cloud and DevOps operations, drive best practices for Kubernetes, observability, automation, and disaster recovery, and use data and metrics to continuously improve our services. You remain technically strong and able to dive into details when needed, while focusing much of your time on team leadership, coordination, and cross‑functional collaboration.  WHAT YOU WILL DO  Team & Organizational Leadership   Lead, mentor, and grow the CloudOps and DevOps teams, setting clear expectations, providing continuous feedback, and supporting professional development.  Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation for complex, high‑impact technical and operational issues affecting customers, the platform, or internal teams.  Lead incident response and triage efforts, including customer‑facing escalations and platform outages, providing clear technical direction, decision‑making, and communication throughout the lifecycle of an incident.  Coordinate team priorities, workload distribution, and on‑call coverage to ensure consistent operational readiness and resilience.  Drive CloudOps and DevOps strategy and roadmap in alignment with product, engineering, and business objectives.  Actively participate in the product development lifecycle, capturing and validating deployment requirements, operational constraints, risks, and runbook considerations for new features and platform changes.  Raise the bar for organizational excellence by enforcing high standards for availability, performance, security, and compliance, ensuring CloudOps and DevOps practices meet or exceed defined SLA and security requirements.  Partner with CloudOps and DevOps leadership to define, evolve, and reinforce operational standards across change management, release processes, and incident response.    Cloud Infrastructure Management   Oversee the architecture, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency of platform infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP, leveraging native cloud services while maintaining consistent operational principles.  Own and evolve governance standards for the use of core cloud services, defining secure, repeatable, and compliant architectural patterns across all environments.  Ensure all environments are properly monitored, secured, and operationally aligned with product and customer requirements.  Provide technical leadership and operational guidance for multi‑cloud and hybrid‑cloud strategies, balancing flexibility, resilience, and cost.  Maintain direct ownership and involvement in the platform’s on‑premise footprint, including Windows‑based desktop and server components, ensuring first‑class build, packaging, and installer experiences for Windows users.  Define and enforce the full software lifecycle for on‑premise and desktop applications, from build pipelines and release artifacts to deployment, upgrade, and supportability considerations.  Ensure cloud‑native infrastructure designs remain compatible with closed and restricted on‑premise deployments, preserving portability, operational feasibility, and customer autonomy.  Drive continuous improvements to infrastructure design that support both highly scalable cloud deployments and secure, self‑contained on‑premise installations.    Kubernetes Orchestration & Automation   Lead day‑to‑day infrastructure and application‑level operations, with deep hands‑on involvement in Kubernetes platforms (EKS, GKE, AKS), serverless workloads, and cloud‑native infrastructure, enforcing the highest standards of availability and resilience.  Own and oversee Kubernetes operations end‑to‑end, including cluster lifecycle management, capacity planning, upgrades, and workload reliability.  Govern all networking, connectivity, and security‑adjacent infrastructure, including ingress controllers, service mesh, gateways, firewalls, VPNs, and inter‑environment connectivity.  Drive a strong automation‑first culture across the CloudOps organization, enforcing standardization and repeatability through infrastructure‑as‑code and GitOps practices.  Lead and evolve automation pipelines using tools such as Terraform, Terragrunt, ArgoCD, Helm, and Ansible, ensuring consistency across cloud and on‑premise environments.  Define and enforce standardized deployment strategies, including rolling updates and blue/green rollouts, to minimize operational risk and service disruption.  Establish and rigorously apply change management procedures for infrastructure and application changes, reducing release risk while maintaining delivery velocity.  Promote continuous improvement and upskilling in Kubernetes and cloud‑native operations, including structured learning paths and certifications where appropriate.    Monitoring, Alerting & Optimization   Own monitoring/observability with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry.  Define and refine SLOs, alerts, and performance metrics.  Use metrics and incidents to drive preventive improvements.  Track/report key CloudOps and DevOps KPIs (uptime, MTTR, change failure rate, deployment frequency).    Database & Data Platform Management   Guide production MongoDB, Redis, MySQL operations (scale, backup, failover, performance).  Ensure databases are monitored, secure, and well integrated.  Work with data/app teams on capacity and growth planning for DBs and caches.    Security & Compliance   Champion secure cloud practices (RBAC, encryption, segmentation, audits).  Oversee SSO and identity federation (OAuth, SAML, OIDC).  Support Security/Compliance to meet required standards.  Assist with security assessments/audits, remediation, and process improvements.    Automation, CI/CD & Infrastructure‑as‑Code   Promote infrastructure‑as‑code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, etc.).  Partner with DevOps/engineering on reliable, auditable CI/CD pipelines.  Drive reuse of automation for provisioning, deployment, and configuration.  Support CI/CD and release governance, ensuring agreed quality/security/rollback controls for SaaS and on‑prem.    Networking & Traffic Management   Oversee cloud networking (VPCs, subnets, NAT, target groups, ACLs).  Guide service mesh and traffic management for microservices.  Help standardize network patterns and connectivity across cloud, data centers, and partners.    Cost Management & Capacity Planning   Monitor and optimize cloud costs with Finance and Product/Engineering.  Use tagging/reporting to attribute spend by product or environment.  Collaborate on capacity planning as usage and customers grow.  Provide cost/capacity summaries to leadership with trends, risks, and optimizations.    Cross‑Functional Collaboration & Communication   Act as a key CloudOps and DevOps partner for Product, DevOps, SRE, Security, and IT.  Join planning to align CloudOps and DevOps initiatives with product and company priorities.  Communicate clearly on platform health, risks, incidents, and improvements.  Serve as an operational escalation point for major incidents/releases, coordinating resolution and follow‑up with leadership and partner teams.    WHAT WE REQUIRE  Experience and skills:   8–10+ years of experience in CloudOps, DevOps, or SRE roles, including formal leadership of engineers or small teams.  Strong hands‑on experience with Azure, GCP (GKE, Load Balancers, Cloud Run, App Engine, BigQuery) and AWS (EKS, EC2, IAM, VPC, Load Balancing, Route 53, security groups, etc.).  Deep expertise in Kubernetes operations, containerized microservices, and tooling (EKS, GKE, Helm, etc.).  Proven experience managing well known, production grade, monitoring/observability frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry) and defining SLOs and alerting.  Advanced knowledge of MongoDB (Sharded Clusters), Redis, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Kafka and MySQL administration in production environments.  Strong skills in Terraform, ArgoCD, Helm, Ansible, and CI/CD practices for infrastructure and platform automation.  Solid understanding of OAuth, SAML, OIDC, identity federation, and secure infrastructure design.  Demonstrated ability to use operational and reliability metrics to guide improvements in cloud operations.  Experience working with or supporting multi‑cloud and/or hybrid‑cloud environments, providing operational input on performance, risk, and feasibility.  Experience tracking and reporting CloudOps/DevOps KPIs (e.g., uptime, MTTR, deployment frequency, change failure rate) to support continuous improvement.    Proficiency in written and spoken English .  Soft skills   Strong leadership and people development capabilities  Analytical thinker with the ability to break down complex problems  Detail‑oriented, results‑driven, and passionate about system reliability  Clear communicator across technical and business teams  Passion for working and learning in a fast‑growing company.  Ability to collaborate effectively in agile and cross‑functional environments to achieve common goals.  Proactive learning new technologies, industry trends, and adapting to evolving tools and methodologies.    EDUCATION   Bachelor's Degree in related fields such as: Bachelor’s Degree, Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Related technical field.  Certifications as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, or GCP DevOps Engineer, are a plus.  Master’s Degree: Specializations in Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, or Software, are a plus.    TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT  This is a full‑time Contractor position.  OUR CULTURE  We offer a dynamic, culturally diverse, and fun environment where people with energy, creativity, and passion work together to deliver amazing product experiences for our customers. Join a team where your background is valued and respected, and your unique insights and ideas contribute to building a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion.  EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY  Seagull Software, LLC, is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of recruiting and employment.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Job Category  Sales  About Salesforce  Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.  Ready to level‑up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.  Enterprise Architect – Agentforce & Data Cloud   Enterprise AI Transformation to lead our most strategic architecture engagements with our marquee customers at the intersection of AI, enterprise platforms, and digital transformation. In this role, you will partner directly with CIOs, CTOs, and Chief Architects at the world’s largest enterprises to help them reimagine their businesses through AI‑powered innovation on the Salesforce Platform.  You will drive the architectural vision for how the Salesforce suite is implemented at the most demanding enterprise scale. This is a high‑trust, high‑impact role shaping the future of how AI transforms customer experience, productivity, and decision‑making for global organizations.  You will also help build a global community of enterprise architects, creating alignment across customers, partners, and Salesforce teams around modern architectural patterns and responsible AI adoption.  Key Responsibilities   Serve as a strategic partner to CIOs, CTOs, and Chief Architects at Fortune 1000 companies, helping shape their enterprise transformation through AI and the Salesforce platform.  Define scalable architectural patterns for end‑to‑end implementation of the Salesforce suite, including AI, Data Cloud, Industry Clouds, and integration technologies.  Lead architectural modernization efforts, bridging legacy enterprise systems with modern cloud‑native infrastructure and AI services.  Champion the use of trusted AI to transform workflows, automate decision‑making, and personalize enterprise experiences at scale.  Establish and grow a global community of Salesforce architects across customers, system integrators (SIs), and ISVs to share best practices, patterns, and platform innovation.  Collaborate with Salesforce Product and Engineering teams to influence the platform roadmap based on real‑world enterprise needs.  Publish architecture blueprints, transformation guides, and reference models that enable repeatable success across verticals.  Design and govern Agentforce architectures, including agentic workflow design, multi‑agent orchestration, and agent lifecycle management across enterprise deployments.  Define AI governance frameworks to ensure responsible, compliant, and auditable AI adoption — including model risk management, bias evaluation, and ethical AI guardrails.  Support strategic pre‑sales engagements by influencing enterprise architecture decisions and accelerating platform adoption across high‑value pursuits.  Provide architectural governance and delivery oversight on complex implementations, ensuring alignment to enterprise standards, scalability requirements, and platform best practices.    What We're Looking For   8+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, platform strategy, or technical advisory roles, with significant focus on cloud transformation and AI integration.  Deep expertise in Salesforce architecture, including Agentforce, Data Cloud, Einstein AI, and Industry Cloud implementations at global scale.  Track record of executive engagement and influence with C‑level leadership at Fortune 1000 companies.  Hands‑on knowledge of AI/ML technologies, including predictive modeling, LLMs, automation, and ethical AI practices in enterprise settings.  Strong understanding of data governance, integration patterns, and multi‑org / hybrid cloud architectures.  Passion for community‑building—mentoring architects, hosting forums, and codifying best practices.  Exceptional communication skills and executive presence; able to lead architectural conversations at both strategic and technical levels.  Experience with Agentforce and Agent Builder, including designing, deploying, and governing autonomous agents in enterprise environments.  Deep industry vertical fluency in one or more sectors (e.g., Financial Services, Retail, Manufacturing, Healthcare) to contextualize architecture recommendations for enterprise customers.  Hands‑on experience with integration platforms — particularly MuleSoft — and the ability to design robust, scalable data and API strategies across complex enterprise landscapes.    Preferred Qualifications   Experience in a consulting, advisory, or CTO/CIO‑facing role at a system integrator, platform vendor, or enterprise IT team.  Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe) and the ability to define and evolve architectural governance frameworks tailored to AI‑driven transformation programs.  Thought leadership or speaking experience at industry events or Salesforce forums (Dreamforce, World Tour, CTA Summit).    Unleash Your Potential  When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. Principais Responsabilidades   Liderar o processo de Demand Planning, assegurando previsões assertivas e consistentes de curto, médio e longo prazo, alinhadas à estratégia do negócio.  Integrar e consolidar informações das áreas de Vendas, Marketing, Trade Marketing, Operações, Supply Chain e Finanças, garantindo alinhamento, visão única da demanda e tomada de decisão integrada.  Propor e executar plano estruturado de melhoria e aprimoramento do processo de S&OP, focando no aumento da maturidade deste processo, aumento da acuracidade da previsão de demanda, minimização das restrições de disponibilidade de produto e aumento de nível de serviço alinhado com as necessidades dos negócios.  Coordenar e conduzir o processo de S&OP / IBP, participando ativamente das reuniões operacionais e executivas, assegurando governança, qualidade das informações e direcionamento estratégico.  Analisar tendências de mercado, histórico de vendas, lançamentos, promoções e sazonalidades, realizando ajustes contínuos na previsão de demanda.  Liderar o time responsável pelo processo de Planejamento Mestre de Produção de todo portfólio de produto acabado dos negócios de Home Care e Personal Care, garantindo otimização das capacidades de produção das fábricas próprias da Flora, bem como da capacidade de produção dos Terceiros, procurando minimizar as restrições de atendimento e focando na maximização da disponibilidade de produtos.  Liderar o time responsável pelo Planejamento de Produção de Terceiros de Personal Care, garantindo alinhamento dos planos de produção com os Provedores, planejamento de materiais para atendimento das produções, disponibilidade de materiais no prazo para os Terceiros e execução dos follow ups de entrega junto aos parceiros, com foco nas entregas dos planos de produção acordados.  Gerir o processo de planejamento de abastecimento das plantas terceiras e planta própria com materiais provenientes do Operador Logístico que centraliza o recebimento das compras de fornecedores diretos.  Monitorar, analisar e aprimorar continuamente os indicadores de desempenho, incluindo acurácia da previsão, nível de serviço, rupturas, giro e cobertura de estoque.  Garantir o dimensionamento adequado dos estoques, equilibrando nível de serviço, capital de giro e eficiência operacional, minimizando rupturas, excessos e obsolescência.  Apoiar e definir, em conjunto com as áreas envolvidas, as políticas de estoque (mínimo, máximo e estoque de segurança).  Desenvolver cenários de demanda e produção, análises de risco e planos de contingência frente a variações de mercado, restrições operacionais ou mudanças estratégicas.  Liderar, desenvolver e capacitar a equipe de Planejamento de Demanda, Planejamento Mestre de Produção e Planejamento de Terceiros promovendo cultura analítica, melhoria contínua e alta performance.  Elaborar e apresentar relatórios, análises e apresentações executivas, traduzindo dados complexos em insights estratégicos para suporte à tomada de decisão.    Requisitos e qualificações  O que você precisa ter   Superior em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Logística ou áreas correlatas.  Experiência:  Vasta experiência em áreas como: Planejamento de Demanda, Planejamento Mestre de Produção, S&OP / IBP e Supply Chain.  Diferencial: Certificação APICS    Conhecimentos técnicos importantes   Gestão de demanda (Demand Planning) e previsões e curto, médio e longo prazo. Conhecimento em análise de dados, estatística e ferramentas de previsão.  Processo de S&OP e governança de processos.  Gestão de capacidade de produção (Master Production Planning) e equilíbrio entre fábricas próprias e terceiras  Otimização de inventário atrelado a nível de serviço a clientes (disponibilidade de produtos)  Identificação de riscos de suprimentos de produtos e cenários de planos de mitigação.  Melhoria contínua de processos.    Informações adicionais  Nossos Benefícios  Para sua tranquilidade financeira   Bônus anual;  Vale Refeição;  Vale alimentação mensal;  Cesta de produtos Flora todos os meses.    Para sua mobilidade   Estacionamento no local.    Para seu bem-estar   Frutas no café da manhã;  Gympass e/ou TotalPass;  Assistência médica e odontológica (com coparticipação);  Seguro de vida.    Para quem cuida de alguém   Auxílio creche para colaboradoras com filhos pequenos;  Kit maternidade especial, com todo carinho da Flora;  Canal Flora Cuida: um espaço de acolhimento emocional e orientação para diferentes momentos da vida. Esta função oferece uma oportunidade única de ajudar a desenhar e escalar a área de riscos financeiros, garantindo práticas sólidas de gestão de risco enquanto apoia a rápida expansão da empresa e o lançamento de novos produtos financeiros. Requisitos   Graduação em Economia, Engenharia, Matemática/Estatística, Administração ou áreas correlatas;  Excel em nível avançado e experiência com gestão e análise de dados;  Inglês em nível profissional (Professional Working Proficiency);  Experiência em Riscos Financeiros. Monitors and manages enterprise risks related to talent, compliance, engagement, and culture at scale, ensuring long‑term workforce sustainability and organizational health.  Partners with Talent Acquisition on sourcing strategies and execution needed to address key talent gaps (e.g., critical leadership roles, market mapping for succession, and leadership pipeline programs).  Partners with Learning & Development on the execution of programs associated with leadership development, people leader effectiveness, onboarding, and mentoring.  Enables strategic talent management practices such as early identification, understanding employee motivators, career acceleration assignments, and reward/recognition. Leads and develops the HR leadership team (Senior Managers), ensuring the People function operates as a high‑performing business partner across the entire organization. Minimum requirements   Bachelor's degree.  Ability to work full time out of the São Paulo Office.  10+ years of evolving responsibility within HR functions, including tenure as a strategic HRBP.  5+ years of people leadership in complex projects, programs, and multi‑year initiatives.  Proven success demonstrating a high degree of autonomy and the ability to drive hands‑on strategic execution within a complex matrix.  Deep understanding of Brazil labor market and Latin America regional dynamics.  Demonstrated ability to navigate a global matrix model, collaborating across regional lines and with corporate Centers of Excellence (CoEs).  Fluency in Portuguese and English. title: Cloud & DevOps Engineering, Principal
description:
Confira a vaga para Cloud & DevOps Engineering, Principal em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

WHO WE ARE Seagull Software, LLC, is a global leader in real-time, item-level visibility and label management solutions, dedicated to powering the world’s most complex supply chains with innovative tools for traceability, authentication, and automated inventory management. Our BarTender platform enables businesses across all industries to design, manage, print, and automate the production of labels, barcodes, and RFID tags, ensuring seamless tracking and compliance for over 100 billion unique identifiers each year. Leveraging the Mojix high-security, scalable SaaS traceability platform, Seagull delivers end-to-end intelligence, harmonizing data to drive operational efficiency, enhance customer experiences, and reduce risk. Learn more at  We’re a growing, profitable, mid-size business with a 40-year history of leading in our field. Headquartered in Redmond, Washington, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia, Seagull empowers businesses worldwide to keep their products moving, traceable, and safe. You’ll work with global, talented, and diverse teams, passionate about what they do and its impact on everyone, everywhere. Join us and help shape the way the world works. LOCATION This direct contractor position is remote in Brazil or LATAM. JOB SUMMARY The Cloud & DevOps Engineering Principal  leads the operations functions responsible for the architecture, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of our multi-cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP. This role manages a team of CloudOps and DevOps engineers, defines operating standards, and partners closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Security to ensure our platforms are secure, scalable, and highly available. This role supports the execution of the broader CloudOps and DevOps strategy , helping to translate high-level direction into concrete operational practices for cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and release management. The role also contributes to the governance and continuous improvement of build and release processes across SaaS and on-premise environments, in alignment with CloudOps leadership. The role is deeply embedded in product development, overseeing the operational impact of new features end-to-end, from architectural design and delivery workflows to scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. This position safeguards the long-term health of the platform by ensuring that new capabilities align with established business processes, preserve performance at scale, and follow a clear, predictable, and repeatable development lifecycle across SaaS and on-premise environments, in close partnership with CloudOps, DevOps and Engineering leadership. As a Cloud & DevOps Engineering Principal, you will shape the roadmap for Cloud and DevOps operations, drive best practices for Kubernetes, observability, automation, and disaster recovery, and use data and metrics to continuously improve our services. You remain technically strong and able to dive into details when needed, while focusing much of your time on team leadership, coordination, and cross-functional collaboration. WHAT YOU WILL DO Team & Organizational Leadership  Lead, mentor, and grow the CloudOps and DevOps teams, setting clear expectations, providing continuous feedback, and supporting professional development. Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation for complex, high-impact technical and operational issues affecting customers, the platform, or internal teams. Lead incident response and triage efforts, including customer-facing escalations and platform outages, providing clear technical direction, decision-making, and communication throughout the lifecycle of an incident. Coordinate team priorities, workload distribution, and on-call coverage to ensure consistent operational readiness and resilience. Drive CloudOps and DevOps strategy and roadmap in alignment with product, engineering, and business objectives. Actively participate in the product development lifecycle, capturing and validating deployment requirements, operational constraints, risks, and runbook considerations for new features and platform changes. Raise the bar for organizational excellence by enforcing high standards for availability, performance, security, and compliance, ensuring CloudOps and DevOps practices meet or exceed defined SLA and security requirements. Partner with CloudOps and DevOps leadership to define, evolve, and reinforce operational standards across change management, release processes, and incident response.  Cloud Infrastructure Management  Oversee the architecture, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency of platform infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP, leveraging native cloud services while maintaining consistent operational principles. Own and evolve governance standards for the use of core cloud services, defining secure, repeatable, and compliant architectural patterns across all environments. Ensure all environments are properly monitored, secured, and operationally aligned with product and customer requirements. Provide technical leadership and operational guidance for multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud strategies, balancing flexibility, resilience, and cost. Maintain direct ownership and involvement in the platform’s on-premise footprint, including Windows-based desktop and server components, ensuring first-class build, packaging, and installer experiences for Windows users. Define and enforce the full software lifecycle for on-premise and desktop applications, from build pipelines and release artifacts to deployment, upgrade, and supportability considerations. Ensure cloud-native infrastructure designs remain compatible with closed and restricted on-premise deployments, preserving portability, operational feasibility, and customer autonomy. Drive continuous improvements to infrastructure design that support both highly scalable cloud deployments and secure, self-contained on-premise installations.  Kubernetes Orchestration & Automation  Lead day-to-day infrastructure and application-level operations, with deep hands-on involvement in Kubernetes platforms (EKS, GKE, AKS), serverless workloads, and cloud-native infrastructure, enforcing the highest standards of availability and resilience. Own and oversee Kubernetes operations end-to-end, including cluster lifecycle management, capacity planning, upgrades, and workload reliability. Govern all networking, connectivity, and security-adjacent infrastructure, including ingress controllers, service mesh, gateways, firewalls, VPNs, and inter-environment connectivity. Drive a strong automation-first culture across the CloudOps organization, enforcing standardization and repeatability through infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices. Lead and evolve automation pipelines using tools such as Terraform, Terragrunt, ArgoCD, Helm, and Ansible, ensuring consistency across cloud and on-premise environments. Define and enforce standardized deployment strategies, including rolling updates and blue/green rollouts, to minimize operational risk and service disruption. Establish and rigorously apply change management procedures for infrastructure and application changes, reducing release risk while maintaining delivery velocity. Promote continuous improvement and upskilling in Kubernetes and cloud-native operations, including structured learning paths and certifications where appropriate.  Monitoring, Alerting & Optimization  Own monitoring/observability with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry. Define and refine SLOs, alerts, and performance metrics. Use metrics and incidents to drive preventive improvements. Track/report key CloudOps and DevOps KPIs (uptime, MTTR, change failure rate, deployment frequency).  Database & Data Platform Management  Guide production MongoDB, Redis, MySQL operations (scale, backup, failover, performance). Ensure databases are monitored, secure, and well integrated. Work with data/app teams on capacity and growth planning for DBs and caches.  Security & Compliance  Champion secure cloud practices (RBAC, encryption, segmentation, audits). Oversee SSO and identity federation (OAuth, SAML, OIDC). Support Security/Compliance to meet required standards. Assist with security assessments/audits, remediation, and process improvements.  Automation, CI/CD & Infrastructure-as-Code  Promote infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, etc.). Partner with DevOps/engineering on reliable, auditable CI/CD pipelines. Drive reuse of automation for provisioning, deployment, and configuration. Support CI/CD and release governance, ensuring agreed quality/security/rollback controls for SaaS and on-prem.  Networking & Traffic Management  Oversee cloud networking (VPCs, subnets, NAT, target groups, ACLs). Guide service mesh and traffic management for microservices. Help standardize network patterns and connectivity across cloud, data centers, and partners.  Cost Management & Capacity Planning  Monitor and optimize cloud costs with Finance and Product/Engineering. Use tagging/reporting to attribute spend by product or environment. Collaborate on capacity planning as usage and customers grow. Provide cost/capacity summaries to leadership with trends, risks, and optimizations.  Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication  Act as a key CloudOps and DevOps partner for Product, DevOps, SRE, Security, and IT. Join planning to align CloudOps and DevOps initiatives with product and company priorities. Communicate clearly on platform health, risks, incidents, and improvements. Serve as an operational escalation point for major incidents/releases, coordinating resolution and follow-up with leadership and partner teams.  WHAT WE REQUIRE  Experience and skills: 8–10+ years of experience in CloudOps, DevOps, or SRE roles, including formal leadership of engineers or small teams. Strong hands-on experience with Azure, GCP (GKE, Load Balancers, Cloud Run, App Engine, BigQuery) and AWS (EKS, EC2, IAM, VPC, Load Balancing, Route 53, security groups, etc.). Deep expertise in Kubernetes operations, containerized microservices, and tooling (EKS, GKE, Helm, etc.). Proven experience managing well known, production-grade, monitoring/observability frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) and defining SLOs and alerting. Advanced knowledge of MongoDB (Sharded Clusters), Redis, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Kafka and MySQL administration in production environments. Strong skills in Terraform, ArgoCD, Helm, Ansible, and CI/CD practices for infrastructure and platform automation. Solid understanding of OAuth, SAML, OIDC, identity federation, and secure infrastructure design. Demonstrated ability to use operational and reliability metrics to guide improvements in cloud operations. Experience working with or supporting multi-cloud and/or hybrid-cloud environments, providing operational input on performance, risk, and feasibility. Experience tracking and reporting CloudOps/DevOps KPIs (e.g., uptime, MTTR, deployment frequency, change failure rate) to support continuous improvement.  Proficiency in written and spoken English. Soft skills: Strong leadership and people development capabilities Analytical thinker with the ability to break down complex problems Detail-oriented, results-driven, and passionate about system reliability Clear communicator across technical and business teams Passion for working and learning in a fast-growing company. Ability to collaborate effectively in agile and cross-functional environments to achieve common goals. Proactive learning new technologies, industry trends, and adapting to evolving tools and methodologies.  EDUCATION Bachelor's Degree in related fields such as: Bachelor’s Degree, Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Related technical field. Certifications as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, or GCP DevOps Engineer, are a plus. Master’s Degree: Specializations in Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, or Software, are a plus.  TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT This is a full-time Contractor position. OUR CULTURE We offer a dynamic, culturally diverse, and fun environment where people with energy, creativity, and passion work together to deliver amazing product experiences for our customers. Join a team where your background is valued and respected, and your unique insights and ideas contribute to building a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Seagull Software, LLC, is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of recruiting and employment. #LI-Remote#LI-Hybrid#LI-LATAM#LI-Brazil   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Gerenciar pessoas, demandas e projetos da área de infraestrutura, definindo prioridades, planos de trabalho e alocação de recursos entre Infraestrutura e Field Service, conduzindo rituais de gestão, acompanhando entregas e alinhando status com a liderança executiva, de forma a assegurar qualidade, prazo, desenvolvimento do time e transparência para a gestão. Gerir riscos operacionais, continuidade e custos da infraestrutura, assegurando a existência e efetividade de planos de backup, disaster recovery e continuidade de negócios, bem como o controle e a otimização de custos de infraestrutura e serviços, especialmente em ambientes cloud, em alinhamento às diretrizes corporativas. description:

Descrição da vaga   Evoluir os pacientes em seu plantão, examinando-os, prescrevendo-os e ministrando tratamentos para as diversas patologias, aplicando métodos da medicina aceitos e reconhecidos cientificamente, seguindo o Plano Terapêutico definido;  Registrar em prontuário do paciente, o diagnóstico, tratamento e evolução da doença;  Emitir atestados diversos, laudos e pareceres, para atender a determinações legais;  Desenvolver ações de saúde coletiva e participar de processos de vigilância em saúde, visando garantir a qualidade dos serviços prestados.    Responsabilidades e atribuições   Desempenhar suas atividades, respeitando os princípios do Código de Ética Médica e cumprindo as normas de trabalho designadas pelo regulamento interno do hospital;  Prestar cuidados ao paciente de acordo com a respectiva especialidade (cirurgião geral, clínica médica, neonatologia, obstetrícia, ortopedia, pediatria, psiquiatria, UCI, UTI adulto, UTI pediátrica) respeitando as orientações do médico assistente (Plano Terapêutico), e comunicar este sobre modificações importantes no quadro evolutivo do mesmo;  Prestar atendimento de urgência e emergência a todo paciente admitido nestas condições na unidade de Pronto Atendimento;  Prestar informações médicas ao paciente ou responsável legal, de acordo com sua capacidade de compreensão, quando solicitado e/ou necessário, em conformidade com orientação do médico assistente (registrar em prontuário médico);  Prestar informações médicas aos acompanhantes e familiares, sempre com autorização do paciente, de acordo com sua capacidade de compreensão, quando solicitado e/ou necessário registrando em conformidade com orientação do médico assistente (registrar em prontuário médico);  Efetuar o planejamento das admissões e altas (Plano Terapêutico) em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional e supervisionar os cuidados clínicos efetuados na unidade;  Admitir os pacientes na unidade, solicitando os documentos necessários e efetuando os devidos registros e controles internos, bem como programar e realizar as altas da unidade;  Examinar, evoluir e prescrever os pacientes (do pronto atendimento, da recuperação pós-anestésica do centro cirúrgico, do centro obstétrico ou da enfermaria), checando exames e alterações fisiológicas e definindo condutas em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional, médico assistente e família/paciente;  Atender avaliações de urgência e emergência em outras áreas do hospital quando solicitado, o mais breve possível, registrando suas condutas e observações adequadamente, no prontuário médico do paciente;  Atender interconsultas em outras áreas do hospital quando solicitado, registrando suas observações adequadamente no prontuário medico do paciente;  Avaliar as solicitações de avaliação médica solicitado, registrando suas observações adequadamente no prontuário médico do paciente;  Solicitar vaga externa através da Central de Regulação de Vagas, sempre que o hospital não dispuser de vaga ou de serviço necessário. Nestes casos, informar seu coordenador;  Informar ao coordenador da equipe os casos com evolução prolongada, intercorrências não esperadas ou intercorrências sociais que ocorram durante o seu plantão;  Detectar e comunicar os órgãos competentes a existência de doadores, doenças de notificação compulsória e/ou casos de violência;  Participar de programas de qualidade da unidade, incluindo coleta de informações;  Participar de reuniões clínicas e administrativas para promover o aperfeiçoamento do serviço, bem como de eventos externo-internos, quando solicitado;  Colaborar a participar na implementação de protocolos de assistência, pesquisa e ensino;  Interagir com os demais departamentos da instituição e áreas envolvidas no atendimento ao paciente, buscando o aprimoramento técnico e troca de experiências para melhoria constante das atividades da área;  Responder as solicitações do Serviço de Atenção ao Usuário referente à sua especialidade e atendimento;  Colaborar e participar do gerenciamento de risco da instituição;  Manter ao coordenador da unidade e da equipe informada sobre as atividades e problemas sob sua responsabilidade.    Requisitos e qualificações   Ensino superior completo em Medicina;  Registro no Conselho ativo (CRM);  Conhecimento em informática - nível usuário. Referência em inovação, criatividade e respeito às diferenças, o Publicis Groupe é o grupo de comunicação mais valorizado no mercado. Com 100 mil colaboradores atuando em mais de 100 países – e interconectados pela plataforma de IA Marcel – somos um parceiro estratégico no processo de transformação dos nossos clientes. Atuamos com base na filosofia do Power of One, que permite que as marcas avancem na personalização em escala e encontrem todos os serviços de que precisam no mesmo lugar, com a possibilidade de customizá-los de acordo com suas demandas. No Brasil, o Publicis Groupe conta com 2.500 colaboradores divididos em agências de publicidade e empresas especialistas que são referências em suas áreas de atuação: DPZ, LePub, Leo, Publicis Brasil, Talent, ARC, BR Media, Epsilon, PMX, PXP e Publicis Edge. Essa oportunidade é para atuação na Publicis Edge,  que é a marca que nasceu na Ásia, e hoje tem presença na China, em Singapura, na Austrália e no Brasil, com a missão de oferecer soluções proprietárias para acelerar a transformação dos negócios dos clientes em áreas como mídia preditiva, social, commerce, e retail media. Sobre a vaga Buscamos uma pessoa Sênior para liderar a frente de BI, mensuração e insights de mídia, garantindo excelência técnica, consistência de métricas e alto impacto nas decisões de negócio. Essa posição combina domínio profundo de Web Analytics, visualização de dados e reporteria de mídia com liderança de equipe e forte interface com alta gestão. Responsabilidades Gerenciar e desenvolver a equipe assegurando entregas ágeis, precisas e alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio; Criar, evoluir e padronizar dashboards dinâmicos e storytelling com dados em Looker Studio, Power BI e Tableau; Conduzir a extração, cruzamento e análise de dados das principais plataformas de Social Media (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads) e Retail Media (Amazon Ads, Mercado Livre Ads); Garantir consistência de métricas, integridade dos dados e qualidade da reporteria, atuando preventivamente sobre inconsistências; Liderar análises ad-hoc para suporte a decisões estratégicas, utilizando Excel/Google Sheets avançado e consultas diretas via SQL/BigQuery; Preparar e conduzir apresentações executivas com insights claros, recomendações estratégicas e foco em impacto de negócio; Atuar como ponto focal entre Analytics, Mídia, Negócios e C‑Level, garantindo alinhamento e fluidez na tomada de decisão.  Qualificações Domínio avançado em ferramentas de Web Analytics e tagueamento (Google Analytics 4, Adobe Analytics, Google Tag Manager); Expertise consolidada em criação de dashboards dinâmicos, storytelling com dados e visualização (Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau); Conhecimento profundo na extração, cruzamento e reporteria de dados das principais plataformas de Social Media (Meta, TikTok, Google) e Retail Media (Amazon, Mercado Livre); Conhecimento intermediário/avançado na manipulação de dados para análises ad-hoc (Excel/Google Sheets avançado, vivência com SQL e BigQuery para consultas diretas). description:

Se você transita bem entre estratégia, dados e liderança, queremos te conhecer!     Liderar a frente de BI com foco em estratégia de dados e crescimento das contas;  Atuar como liderança direta do time, promovendo desenvolvimento, direcionamento e evolução técnica;  Definir e estruturar caminhos estratégicos de dados para clientes, indo além da relatoria e análise descritiva;  Conectar dados às estratégias de negócio, identificando oportunidades de crescimento e otimização;  Atuar de forma integrada com áreas como Mídia, Planejamento e outras frentes da agência;  Orientar o time na construção de análises, estudos e recomendações estratégicas;  Garantir consistência, qualidade e visão evolutiva das entregas de BI;  Participar de discussões estratégicas com clientes, trazendo uma visão consultiva baseada em dados;  Estruturar e evoluir o uso do ecossistema de dados dentro do ambiente Google;  Contribuir para a organização e escalabilidade da operação de BI.  Experiência sólida em Business Intelligence, com atuação estratégica em dados;  Vivência com liderança de times e gestão de entregas;  Domínio do ecossistema Google (BigQuery, Google Cloud, etc.);  Conhecimento avançado em SQL e estruturação de dados;  Experiência na construção de estratégias orientadas por dados para clientes;  Capacidade de traduzir dados em insights acionáveis e direcionamentos de negócio;  Experiência com integração entre áreas como mídia, planejamento ou marketing.    Diferenciais:    Vivência em ambientes de agência;  Experiência prática com implementações de MMM (Marketing Mix Modeling) e/ou modelos de atribuição;  Conhecimento em áreas correlatas como CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) e SEO. description:

Descrição da vaga  á pensou em trabalhar em uma multinacional de grande porte e impactar no que realmente importa? A Ecolab é o seu lugar! Nossa empresa desenvolve soluções e tecnologias para alimentos seguros, ambientes limpos, prevenção de infecções e economia de água aos nossos clientes em mais de 170 países!  Estamos com uma vaga em aberto para atuar conosco como Supervisor de Serviços  em nosso setor de Grain Protection  para Tatuí, em São Paulo  A Ecolab acredita na inclusão e na promoção da diversidade em todas as suas formas. Temos como valor e premissa, o respeito e valorização das pessoas e combatemos qualquer tipo de discriminação. Ao fazer parte do nosso time, você poderá participar ativamente da construção da Diversidade, Equidade & Inclusão na companhia e ser um aliado dos nossos Grupos de Afinidade, como o E3 (focado no desenvolvimento de mulheres), o Ecoessence (focado no desenvolvimento de pessoas negras), e do Pride (LGBTQIAP+)  Quer saber mais sobre a Ecolab? Assista no nosso Video Institucional  Responsabilidades e atribuições  Atividades do Cargo    Você será responsável por supervisionar, acompanhar e controlar os serviços de controle de pragas em grãos realizados pelos técnicos de serviços de sua equipe dentro dos clientes;  Treinar e orientar, permanentemente, os técnicos de sua equipe conforme as boas práticas e protocolos estabelecidos para realizar o melhor atendimento aos clientes;  Realizar análises dos relatórios de visitas e de amostragens emitidos pela sua equipe;  Elaborar planos de ação e procedimentos para implantação, modificação, ampliação e/ou redução do escopo de serviços nos clientes, adequando a operação ao serviço contratado pelo cliente;  Visitar cada um dos clientes em sua área de atuação, mantendo contato e um bom relacionamento com os clientes e prepostos envolvidos direta ou indiretamente com nosso serviço;  Sair a campo, pelo menos uma vez por mês, com cada membro de sua equipe, verificando se os atendimentos e protocolos estão sendo aplicados corretamente;  Orientar e suportar a sua equipe na elaboração da agenda de serviços, minimizando deslocamentos excessivos e conflitos entre rotas;  Conferir o controle de volume dos produtos utilizados nas operações dos clientes, verificando o estoque e solicitando a compra quando necessário;  Conferir o estado de conservação dos equipamentos, veículos e celulares da sua equipe, tomando as ações necessárias relativas a manutenções e trocas;  Identificar oportunidades de novos negócios, nos próprios clientes como em outros que estejam localizados dentro da sua rota e compartilhar com o time de vendas;  Identificar e propor novas soluções para agregar valor ao cliente;  Supervisionar e controlar as tarefas administrativas como controle de jornada de trabalho, férias, desligamentos, seleção de candidatos, carreira, processos no sistema, e-mails e dúvidas dos colaboradores.    Requisitos e qualificações  Pré-Requisitos    É necessário possuir Graduação ou Formação Técnica completa em áreas como Administração, Biologia, Veterinária, Engenharia Agronômica, Química ou relacionadas;  Experiência na gestão de serviços em operações para clientes, incluindo a coordenação de equipes de facilities ou serviços.  Imprescindível experiência com gestão e treinamento de equipes operacionais;  Necessário experiência com Pacote Office (Excel, Word e Outlook), ferramentas de informática, aplicativos de celular e sistemas internos;  Carteira de Habilitação Categoria B válida e ativa por no mínimo 2 anos, além de habilidades na condução de veículos;  Disponibilidade de horário e para viagens;  Boa comunicação;    Diferenciais    Capacidade de entrega consistente de metas e resultados;  Experiência com atendimento ao cliente e resolução de conflitos;  Planejamento, organização e disciplina;  Habilidades com ferramentas de informática.    Informações adicionais  Auxílio Alimentação, Carro da Companhia, Convênio Médico e Odontológico, Gympass, Seguro de Vida, Participação nos Lucros, Previdência Privada, Programa de Treinamentos Internos e Auxílio Educação.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Head of Legal
description:

About InPlanet  InPlanet is a mission‑driven, remote‑first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW)  in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.  Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils  in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders – and we’re growing fast.  Our company culture blends people‑first care  andperformance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symoolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.  We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil – where the real climate impact happens.  You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people find interviewing with us.  Check out our Culture page here.  About the Role  We are looking for a Head of Legal  to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business  in a highly complex, science‑, operations‑ and contract‑based environment.  This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets , requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives  across Brazil and international markets.  This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast‑growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. A structured business mindset and a holistic approach to the needs of a growing startup are essential, and these qualities will be assessed throughout the interview process.  The Impact you can make   Enable the company to scale effectively  through strong legal foundations  Act as the legal backbone for strategic decisions , from operations to international expansion  Structure and support complex, cross‑border deals and partnerships   Ensure robust governance, compliance, and risk management  across all activities  Bridge legal across Science, Operations, Supply, Business Development and People   Strengthen investor confidence  through clear and reliable legal frameworks  Manage external network of trusted legal advisors    Core working relationships  Directly reporting to the CFO.   Internal      Science & Operations Team, HR, Business Development, Leadership & Investors      External      Legal boutiques (contracts & commercial), Tax advisors, Governance specialists, Regulatory bodies        Context of the role   You will join a lean and evolving legal function , with high ownership from day one  Legal demand is rapidly growing alongside company scale   Strong need to connect legal across international teams  (Science, Carbon, BD)  The role has potential to evolve into VP Legal , depending on scope and impact    Key Responsibilities   Act as the central legal hub  across all company functions, both locally (Brazil) and internationally  Lead due diligence processes  (legal and regulatory)  Structure, negotiate, and manage complex contracts , including:      Farmers, Mining partners, NDAs, Joint ventures, International commercial agreements, Corporate documentation (e.g. Investment agreements)      Own cross‑border legal strategy and execution   Strengthen and improve corporate governance and entity structures  (Brazil & international)  Work closely with tax advisors   Ensure compliance across multiple regulatory domains , including environmental, mining, agribusiness, and carbon markets  Support the People Team  with labour and service provision requirement  Support investor relations  from a legal standpoint  Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructure     You can be a Rock‑Star if you have  Core Skills & Experience   Law degree with active OAB registration (Brazil)   8–15+ years of experience , ideally with strong exposure to environmental, operations or infrastructure‑related sectors  Proven experience in:      Commercial and business law, ideally from a startup angle   Due diligence (legal & regulatory)   Complex contract structuring and negotiation   International contracts and cross‑border operations       Strong background in business‑oriented legal roles  (e.g., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)  Solid experience with:      Corporate law and governance   Investor relations and strategic partnerships       Fluency in English , with experience working in international environments    Key Qualities   Business‑oriented mindset : understands legal as a driver of growth  Highly relational : strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions  Strategic thinker : connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks  Pragmatic and solution‑driven : balances risk with execution speed  High ownership : comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure  Strong institutional presence : capable of representing the company externally  Structured and integrative : able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains  Neutral and sound judgment , especially in complex or sensitive matters    Bonus Points (but not essential)   Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets   Background in startups, scale‑ups, or boutique law firms   Exposure to governance and international structures   Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)  Business and legal experience in Germany   Speaks German  Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SP    Living Our Values  At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.   Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes  Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands‑on, can‑do attitude, propelled by urgency  Impact : You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change    Benefits   Compensation  expectations and our compensation philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.  Equity  to feel like an owner  Home Office Budget   Fully Remote : Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5‑hour time zones).  Personal development budget   Language Programme  Monthly Allowance  40+ days  annual leave  The opportunity to be autonomous,  make a huge difference and belong to a vision.  Occasional off‑sites  in Brazil yay!  Laptop  to fuel your productivity    InPlanet Compensation Philosophy  At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.  The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce. We utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach.  These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.  Application Process  Roughly 8 hours across 6‑8 weeks from CV‑screening.   Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)  Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)  Optional third interview  Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)  Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling  Offer    To hear about updates on future opportunities, please follow us on LinkedIn. To keep up with InPlanet market updates, subscribe to our Newsletter.  How to Apply   We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese). Each engagement is carefully assessed on a case‑by‑case basis to ensure alignment with applicable laws and InPlanet’s global operating standards.  Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourably treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. Descrição da vaga  NaTirolez , somos uma marca 100% brasileira, com mais de quatro décadas de história, movida pela paixão em fazer bem‑feito e pelo cuidado em cada detalhe, do campo à mesa. Produzimos alimentos que fazem parte da vida das pessoas porque acreditamos que qualidade, carinho e responsabilidade caminham juntos. Aqui, nosso maior ingrediente sempre foram aspessoas . Buscamos pessoas que queiram crescer junto com a gente, que tenham orgulho do que fazem e que acreditem que resultados sustentáveis são construídos todos os dias, com colaboração, respeito e protagonismo.  Conheça nossos ValoreZ:  Valorizamos as pessoas , promovemos um ambiente seguro e produtivo. Respeito, confiança e colaboração são a base das nossas relações. Aqui, cada pessoa importa.  Somos comprometidos . Agimos com ética e integridade, realizamos diálogos transparentes e sinceros e sabemos do impacto que nossas ações geram para colaboradores, clientes e para a sociedade.  Agimos com transparência . Somos responsáveis pelas nossas atitudes, compromissos e resultados. Fazemos acontecer com disciplina, otimizando os recursos, com aprendizado contínuo.  Fazemos bem‑feito . Entregamos o nosso melhor com simplicidade, amor e capricho. Temos orgulho da nossa história, focamos no presente e, com coragem, construímos o futuro.  Nos acompanhe nas redes (@tirolezqueijos)e faça parte da nossa família Tirolez!  Vem #SerTirolez!  Responsabilidades e atribuições   Liderar a área de Planejamento Financeiro, assegurando alocação eficiente de recursos humanos e financeiros, adoção de boas práticas e disciplina de execução.  Atuar como indutor da eficiência econômico‑financeira da Companhia, promovendo desafios estruturados de produtividade, racionalização de custos e captura de valor em todas as áreas, com monitoramento sistemático dos resultados e impactos no desempenho global.  Garantir o fechamento mensal de resultados, com qualidade, consistência e aderência aos calendários corporativos, coordenando e influenciando as áreas envolvidas, especialmente nos processos de Budget e Forecast.  Analisar variações, desvios e impactos nos resultados e nas projeções da Companhia, identificando causas, riscos e oportunidades, e propor planos de correção de rota e iniciativas de eficiência à Diretorias responsáveis. Estruturar e acompanhar os planos de investimento (CAPEX), incluindo análise de viabilidade, priorização de projetos, controle de execução, reporte de payback e monitoramento do retorno sobre o capital investido.  Conduzir o acompanhamento das despesas operacionais, estimulando a cultura de dono, a disciplina orçamentária e a identificação contínua de oportunidades de eficiência e otimização de gastos.  Avaliar periodicamente o sistema de custeio, garantindo adequada alocação de custos, aderência a critérios técnicos, transparência e suporte qualificado à tomada de decisão e aos desafios de eficiência das áreas.  Participar ativamente dos principais fóruns de gestão e governança, incluindo S&OP, S&OE, fechamento de despesas e resultados, planejamento estratégico, fórum de compras, reuniões de operações, comitê de riscos, projetos de M&A, projeções de fluxo de caixa, balanço e auditorias interna e externa.  Preparar e consolidar o reporte mensal ao Board Executivo e ao Conselho de Administração, com foco nos principais direcionadores de performance, eficiência operacional, riscos e geração de valor.  Definir e controlar as alçadas de aprovação e a delegação de poderes, fortalecendo a governança financeira, o compliance e a disciplina de capital da Companhia.  Espera-se que o Gerente de FP&A utilize Inteligência Artificial para antecipar resultados, acelerar análises, elevar a qualidade das decisões e induzir eficiência em toda a Companhia, mantendo governança, ética e disciplina financeira.”    Requisitos e qualificações  Formação desejável:    Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, entre outras.  Pós-graduação ou especialização em gestão financeira ou gestão de negócio. title: Parceiro de Negócios de Tributos Indiretos (Híbrido)
description:
Empresa está contratando Parceiro de Negócios de Tributos Indiretos (Híbrido) em cajamar. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

O Parceiro de Negócios de Tributos será responsável por uma equipe de três pessoas, atuando estrategicamente junto às áreas da empresa, identificando oportunidades de otimização fiscal e gerenciando riscos tributários. Será responsável por liderar projetos, supervisionar o compliance fiscal e coordenar prestadores de serviços externos. Também atuará como ponto focal para auditorias e garantirá a acuracidade das operações fiscais, incluindo a liderança da equipe de faturamento. A função exige forte conhecimento em tributos indiretos, liderança de projetos e foco em melhoria de processos e eficiência.  O que você fará:   Atuar como parceiro de negócios em tributos indiretos, apoiando áreas comerciais e operacionais com orientação estratégica, identificação de oportunidades e avaliação de riscos.   Liderar projetos de eficiência e otimização tributária, garantindo alinhamento com objetivos do negócio e conformidade.   Supervisionar as atividades de compliance tributário de ponta a ponta, incluindo declarações e obrigações acessórias.   Gerenciar prestadores de serviços fiscais externos, assegurando qualidade, prazos e aderência ao escopo.   Atuar como líder tributário no projeto de Reforma Tributária, incluindo planejamento, processos, testes e coordenação com stakeholders.   Monitorar mudanças na legislação tributária e avaliar impactos, propondo ações adequadas.   Liderar projetos tributários, gerenciar a equipe de Faturamento e garantir precisão operacional e conformidade fiscal.   Impulsionar melhorias de processos, automação e eficiência, além de gerir, desenvolver e avaliar a equipe, promovendo uma cultura de responsabilidade e melhoria contínua.     O que você precisa:  Requisitos Obrigatórios:   Graduação em Contabilidade, Direito, Economia ou áreas correlatas, com experiência sólida em tributos indiretos, preferencialmente em ambientes multinacionais ou complexos.   Forte conhecimento da legislação tributária brasileira nos níveis federal, estadual e municipal.   Experiência na liderança de equipes, projetos tributários e implementação de processos.   Experiência na gestão de consultores fiscais externos ou prestadores de serviços.   Domínio de Excel.   Experiência em antecipar cenários, propor soluções e estruturar estratégias legais para redução da carga tributária.     Requisitos Desejáveis:   Inglês avançado é desejável.   Conhecimento em Power BI.      #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Manager Software Engineering - SAP Concur
description:
Nova oportunidade para Manager Software Engineering - SAP Concur em são leopoldo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

We help the world run better  At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.  SAP Concur, the market leader in integrated travel, expense, and invoice management, has embarked on a journey to reimagine business travel and expenses. In an industry that is becoming increasingly complex with suppliers launching new differentiated product bundles and rich merchandising offers, we have the opportunity to completely rethink the end-to-end experience. We are building our next-generation Online Booking and Expense Management Tool from the ground up, using new technologies to guide business travelers and help them make informed decisions while assisting companies in meeting their objectives regarding policy compliance and budget control.  We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to help develop next-generation microservices utilizing cloud-first concepts and technologies, including containerization, serverless architecture, and an increased reliance on NoSQL data stores. You are organized, positive, creative, and consistently focused on the user. You understand when to make decisions and when to ask questions. You have a strong attention to detail and enjoy discovering new ways to solve users’ problems. Above all, you take pride in building exceptional products.  The Value You Deliver   Collaborate effectively with Technical Product Managers to take ownership and ensure delivery on agreed priorities.  Build high-performing teams by attracting, hiring, retaining, and coaching top talent.  Grow the team and guide the career development of team members, focusing on both the technical and interpersonal skills necessary for being effective and successful in a professional software engineering organization.  Provide systematic and direct individual performance feedback focused on recognition of achievement and opportunities for growth.  Own cloud services from end to end by delivering distributed systems utilizing AWS services and adhering to best practices such as zero-downtime production deployments, canaries, frequent deployments, and feature-flag-driven development.  Build and maintain strong and effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.    Position Requirements   Bachelor's/Master’s Degree or equivalent in a technology-related field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, etc.) required.  Outstanding professional software engineering experience with work on managing engineering teams.  Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end solutions from design through delivery.  Very good understanding of one or more of Go, Java, Kotlin, NodeJS and other modern programming languages.  Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with technical product managers, architects, and technical teams across different product areas.  Knowledge of secure coding practices, compliance, open-source technologies, and frameworks.  DevOps mentality with an understanding of Continuous Delivery and Observability.  Experience with Docker, Helm, Kubernetes, and a broad array of AWS primitives such as EC2, AMIs, EKS, Dynamo, etc.  Familiarity with common compliance frameworks that impact software development: FedRAMP, PCI, SOC1, SOC2, and more.    Value Competencies   Displays passion for & responsibility to the customer.  Displays leadership through innovation in everything you do.  Displays a passion for what you do and a drive to improve.  Displays a relentless commitment to win.  Displays personal & corporate integrity.    The ideal candidate will have a passion for delivering optimal solutions and challenging the status quo. To be successful in this role, you will thrive in an agile environment where teams collaborate towards a common goal.  Bring out your best  SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.  We win with inclusion  SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. description:

Manager Software Engineering - SAP Concur  We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.  SAP Concur, the market leader in integrated travel, expense, and invoice management, has embarked on a journey to reimagine business travel and expenses. In an industry that is becoming increasingly complex with suppliers launching new differentiated product bundles and rich merchandising offers, we have the opportunity to completely rethink the end-to-end experience. We are building our next‑generation Online Booking and Expense Management Tool from the ground up, using new technologies to guide business travelers and help them make informed decisions while assisting companies in meeting their objectives regarding policy compliance and budget control.  We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to help develop next‑generation microservices utilizing cloud‑first concepts and technologies, including containerization, serverless architecture, and an increased reliance on NoSQL data stores. You are organized, positive, creative, and consistently focused on the user. You understand when to make decisions and when to ask questions. You have a strong attention to detail and enjoy discovering new ways to solve users’ problems. Above all, you take pride in building exceptional products.  THE VALUE YOU DELIVER:   Collaborate effectively with Technical Product Managers to take ownership and ensure delivery on agreed priorities.  Build high‑performing teams by attracting, hiring, retaining, and coaching top talent.  Grow the team and guide the career development of team members, focusing on both the technical and interpersonal skills necessary for being effective and successful in a professional software engineering organization.  Provide systematic and direct individual performance feedback focused on recognition of achievement and opportunities for growth.  Own cloud services from end to end by delivering distributed systems utilizing AWS services and adhering to best practices such as zero‑downtime production deployments, canaries, frequent deployments, and feature‑flag‑driven development.  Build and maintain strong and effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.    POSITION REQUIREMENTS:   Bachelor's/Master’s Degree or equivalent in a technology‑related field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, etc.) required.  Outstanding professional software engineering experience with work on managing engineering teams.  Demonstrated ownership of end‑to‑end solutions from design through delivery.  Very good understanding of one or more of Go, Java, Kotlin, NodeJS and other modern programming languages.  Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with technical product managers, architects, and technical teams across different product areas.  Knowledge of secure coding practices, compliance, open‑source technologies, and frameworks.  DevOps mentality with an understanding of Continuous Delivery and Observability.  Experience with Docker, Helm, Kubernetes, and a broad array of AWS primitives such as EC2, AMIs, EKS, Dynamo, etc.  Familiarity with common compliance frameworks that impact software development: FedRAMP, PCI, SOC1, SOC2, and more.    VALUE COMPETENCIES:   Displays passion for & responsibility to the customer.  Displays leadership through innovation in everything you do.  Displays a passion for what you do and a drive to improve.  Displays a relentless commitment to win.  Displays personal & corporate integrity.    The ideal candidate will have a passion for delivering optimal solutions and challenging the status quo. To be successful in this role, you will thrive in an agile environment where teams collaborate towards a common goal.  Bring out your best  SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end‑to‑end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose‑driven and future‑focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.  We win with inclusion  SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well‑being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential.
